name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Rest your upper back across a sturdy bench with one foot planted flat, the opposite knee lifted, and a dumbbell held steadily over your working hip.
Brace your core, tuck your chin slightly, and keep your pelvis level from side to side.
Drive firmly through your planted heel to extend your working hip to full lockout while squeezing your glute hard.
Lower your hips under control back toward the floor, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep both hip bones level at the top rather than letting the unsupported hip drop.
Plant your working foot so your shin stands vertical when your hip reaches full extension.
